capabilities: Visualize all vault notes across map layouts (Emergence, Ideaverse, Starfield, Gravity, Chord, Treemap, Mosaic, Bookshelf)
Replay vault growth month by month with a timelapse animation
Filter maps by years, folders, tags, properties, MOCs, and bases
Edit notes inside the map in an embedded editor with Compass and Arena views
Export map pictures and video clips sized for social sharing
disambiguation: Not geographic maps; 'maps' here are abstract visual layouts of the vault's notes, links, and folders.
extras: Free and open source. Base Builder requires Obsidian 1.10 or later. Large vaults of 10,000+ notes take a while to scan the first time; only changed notes are re-read afterwards. Runs on desktop, tablets, and phones. Several maps are marked Experimental (Tree, Skyline, Geometric, Linear, Planet, Posters, People, Edit mode).
intentEvidence: This is our take on Obsidian's graph view.
problem: Obsidian's built-in graph view shows notes in one force layout and gives little sense of note hierarchy, vault growth over time, or folder and tag structure.
summary: Visualization suite that places every vault note on interactive maps—Emergence, Starfield, Ideaverse, Chord—ranked by links, with timelapse and base views.
